card.name: Metabolizer-status words in drug metabolism
card.fires_on: The word piece "apid" in "ultra-rapid" before "metabolizer", mostly in codeine warnings. Also "lation" in "acetylation" before "rates".

modes.label: Ultra-rapid metabolizers
modes.description: The "apid" piece inside "ultra-rapid" just before "metabolizer(s)" in codeine or promethazine text.
modes.example: individuals who are ultra-r<<apid>> metabolizers should not use Promethazine

modes.label: Acetylation rates
modes.description: The ending of "acetylation" when describing how fast patients process a drug.
modes.example: Dapsone levels are influenced by acety<<lation>> rates.

card.plain: It fires inside words describing how fast a person's body processes a drug, such as ultra-rapid or acetylation.
evidence: Dapsone levels are influenced by acety<<lation>> rates.
